name: armada
description: Run a command over many inputs at once, on Cloudflare Containers.

scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p . && tsc --noEmit -p worker && tsc --noEmit -p worker/tests && tsc --noEmit -p worker/dashboard
scripts.python: cd python && python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v && /opt/armada-python/bin/mypy --strict armada tests/typing_check.py
